newsitem.title: UK: Dlr strong, though not eupohric, in post G7 Europe.
newsitem.headline: Dlr strong, though not eupohric, in post G7 Europe.

text.p: The dollar was strong against the mark and yen in European morning trade after a statement on currencies from the Group of Seven finance ministers which removed the market's inhibitions about dollar strength.
G7 finance ministers said on Sunday that major currency misaligments have been corrected and that excessive currency volatility and deviations from fundamentals were undesirable.
The contents of the G7 statement were mostly in line with what the market had expected, with analysts saying the remarks lacked aggressivenss and had made dollar bulls comfortable.
